thought.text: Login successful — the agent dashboard loads. Let me gather final comprehensive evidence:

reasoning_content:
Login successful! The admin logged into the Qisutu agent portal (dashboard page). The installation is fully functional:

1. ✅ install.sh system preparation completed (exit 0)
2. ✅ 6-step web installer completed (language=de)
3. ✅ installed.lock created
4. ✅ 138 tables in DB, database_version=2.0.2
5. ✅ System settings saved (de language, localhost, admin@example.org)
6. ✅ Bootstrap user deleted
7. ✅ Temporary systemd units removed (qisutu-daemon.service remains)
8. ✅ Daemon running as qisutu user
9. ✅ Apache running, serving /qisutu
10. ✅ Admin login works end-to-end

Let's do the final comprehensive verification and gather all evidence:
- HTTP checks: install.pl (should show "already installed"), index.pl (login), static assets
- Daemon health check (verify it's still running, check logs)
- Confirm that the daemon is actually doing something (check its log output)
- Final state of the systemd files

Also, let's confirm that install.pl now shows the "already installed" state (proving that the installer is locked to this instance).

Let's gather all the final evidence.

action.command:
echo "=== 1. install.pl now locked (should show 'already installed') ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "install.pl http=%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1/qisutu/install.pl
curl -s http://127.0.0.1/qisutu/install.pl | grep -oiE "alreadyinstalled[^<]*|bereits installiert|already installed" | head -2
echo "=== 2. index.pl login page ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "index.pl http=%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1/qisutu/index.pl
echo "=== 3. static asset ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "static css http=%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1/qisutu/static/css/qisutu.css
echo "=== 4. daemon process (as qisutu) ==="
ps -o user,pid,etime,cmd -p $(pgrep -f "perl /opt/qisutu/bin/qisutu-daemon" | head -1)
echo "=== 5. apache & mariadb ==="
pgrep -x apache2 | head -1 && echo "apache2: running"
mariadb-admin ping 2>&1
echo "=== 6. systemd unit state (only daemon should remain) ==="
ls /etc/systemd/system/ | grep -i qisutu
cat /run/qisutu/systemctl.state
echo "=== 7. install log tail ==="
tail -8 /opt/qisutu/var/log/install.log
echo "=== 8. release version ==="
grep "^version=" /opt/qisutu/release.conf
